reason: GraphFlow is primarily a local-first memory and context harness for coding agents, providing code-graph indexing, compressed retrieval, cross-session learning memory, planning support, and MCP/CLI access.

summaries.zh: GraphFlow 是面向编码智能体的本地优先记忆与上下文工具，可索引代码、压缩检索项目知识并通过 CLI 和 MCP 提供跨会话记忆与规划能力。
summaries.en: GraphFlow is a local-first memory and context tool for coding agents that indexes code, compresses project knowledge, and exposes cross-session memory and planning through CLI and MCP.

capabilities: Indexes local source code into a knowledge graph
Stores and retrieves project context and episodic memory across sessions
Exposes context, planning, indexing, diagnostics, and memory functions through CLI and MCP
Automatically captures outcomes through supported agent hooks
Can optionally download an external document-processing binary
